items.html: *These Nekudim expanded from the Tabur of AK to its Sium Raglayim, as in the arrangement of ZON which clothes AA. However, there, ZON clothes all the sides and surroundings of AA, whereas here, their primary illumination is only through the anterior of AK. Yet, some illumination expands from these Nekudim, whether from their lights or from their vessels, and clothe this AK around all its sides, as we explained above regarding the AHP. Still, their illumination is mainly through the anterior.
